title: The Agreements under the Expanded Framework between Singapore and Indonesia
what_it_is: The Agreements under the Expanded Framework between Singapore and Indonesia

sections.label: Leaders' Retreat bilateral agreements signing
sections.summary: The first post-COVID Leaders' Retreat saw ministers sign agreements on the Jakarta-Singapore FIR boundary, extradition, and the 2007 Defence Cooperation Agreement.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: This was our first Leaders' Retreat since the start of COVID-19.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: It was also significant because the Leaders witnessed the signing by the respective Ministers of a set of agreements on three long-standing bilateral issues under an Expanded Framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: These agreements are: first, an Agreement on the Realignment of the Boundary between the Jakarta Flight Information Region (FIR) and the Singapore FIR; second, a Treaty for the Extradition of Fugitives (ET); and third, a Joint Statement between the Defence Ministers on the 2007 Defence Cooperation Agreement (DCA).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security (Mr Teo Chee Hean)
sentences.text: My Indonesian counterpart, Coordinating Minister for Maritime Affairs and Investments, Luhut Pandjaitan, and I also signed an Exchange of Letters in which our governments committed to bring these agreements into force simultaneously.

sections.label: Past FIR and training agreements
sections.summary: Agreements on the FIR and military training were first signed in 1995, but the FIR Agreement could not be implemented due to external factors in the ICAO submission process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: Over the years, we have been working with successive Indonesian governments to resolve these issues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: We first signed agreements on the FIR and military training 27 years ago in 1995, but the FIR Agreement could not be implemented due to external factors in the process of submitting it for approval by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO).

sections.label: Framework for Discussions endorsement
sections.summary: A Framework for Discussions on the FIR and Singapore's military training in the South China Sea was endorsed by Prime Minister Lee and President Jokowi in October 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: We worked out a Framework for Discussions as a basis for our two governments to discuss the FIR and Singapore's military training in the South China Sea.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: This Framework was endorsed by Prime Minister Lee and President Jokowi at the previous Leaders' Retreat in October 2019 to resolve these two issues separately but concurrently.

sections.label: Delegation arrangement duration
sections.summary: The delegation arrangement will last for 25 years and shall be extended by mutual consent if both countries find it beneficial.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The delegation arrangement will last for 25 years and shall be extended by mutual consent if both countries find it beneficial to do so.

sections.label: DCA training arrangements clarity
sections.summary: When the DCA comes into force, it will provide clarity on arrangements for SAF training in Indonesian archipelagic and territorial waters and airspace.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: When the DCA comes into force, it will provide clarity on the arrangements for the SAF's training in Indonesian archipelagic and territorial waters and airspace, with full respect for Indonesia's sovereignty over its territory, while preserving Singapore's rights.

sections.label: Extradition retrospective application change
sections.summary: The only change is retrospective application to extradite fugitives for crimes committed 18 years ago, compared to 15 years in the 2007 agreement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The only change is in its retrospective application to extradite fugitives for crimes committed 18 years ago, as compared to 15 years in the 2007 agreement, starting from the time that the ET comes into force.

sections.label: Implementing agreements through domestic processes
sections.summary: Both sides will implement the agreements through domestic processes and, for the FIR, to ICAO; the agreement lasts 25 years and can be extended by mutual consent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The focus of both sides now is to implement this set of agreements by bringing all of them through our respective domestic processes and, in the case of the FIR, subsequently, to ICAO.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: This agreement shall remain in force for 25 years and shall be extended by mutual consent if both countries find it beneficial to do so.

sections.label: Trust enabling bilateral negotiations
sections.summary: Trust and unity allow consistent negotiations, and the signed agreements show the strength of bilateral relations and will create closer collaborations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: It is this trust and unity of our people behind us that allow us to conduct negotiations with consistency and confidence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: This provides the foundation for building good relations and creates a conducive environment for negotiations, so that we can arrive at a good outcome.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: The signing of this set of agreements and our ability to resolve long-standing and complex bilateral issues in an open and constructive manner demonstrate the strength and maturity of our bilateral relations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Teo Chee Hean
sentences.text: I am confident that, when implemented, these agreements will create opportunities for even closer collaborations in civil aviation, criminal matters and defence cooperation, and also pave the way for us to advance our bilateral relations with Indonesia with friendship, mutual trust and confidence.
